title: Say Boses na Isusumpa
intro: Abayag ni antis ya linma so inmunan too ed dalin, walay sakey a pinalsan walaan na baleg a pakayari ya akaalagey ed sakey a pasen na perpekton kareenan, ya apaliberan na saray sankadebosyonan a kamarerwa. No walay sakey a ganggan ya niiter, balang boses et ontuek ed panagpasakop—balet sakey a boses so inmalagey bilang panagsumlang, tan satan a panagsumlang so onagel ed amin a panaon anggad sampot ya Agew. Siopa iyan naplag a pinalsa?
clues: Pinalsa ak manlapud sakey a bengatla ya manliwawa, bangta saray arum ed abay ko et pinalsa manlapud samay nanakar da.
Nanayam ak ed sakey a sagradon pasen ed limog na saray debosyonadon pinalsa, anggad sakey a ganggan so amabaliktad ed amin.
Nen sinmabi so ganggan, amin a kamarerwa so dinmakmomo likud ed siak; say ag ko labay et nanlapud inkamapaatagey.
Pinataynan ak ed saman a sagradon pasen, a tinandaan na sakey a samba ya mansiansia ya anggad angga.
Kinmerew ak na panaon anggad Agew na Kioli, tan niiter itan. Insipan ko ya asinggeran ko so balang kamarerwa tan ibalang ko ra.
No ontanol so trumpita, saray tinmumbok ed siak et mibiang ed kapalaran ko, a mila rad siak ed mandarlang ya apoy ya anggapoy katulongan a makapangilaban ed sikara.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Iblis
Faraon (Fir'awn)
Namrud
Abu Lahab
Si Azar (say ama nen Ibrahim)

trial.label: Say Makatantandan Panaon
options: Agto labay so ondakmomo ed arap nen Adan
Say pangasamsam ed inka-Dios ed sakey a baleg ya empiryo
Manplaplanon mangibantak ed apoy ed sakey a matunong
Pangidaulo ed totoo pian mandayew ed balitok ya imahen
Nalelener so baleg ya armada ed dayat
trial.answer: Agto labay so ondakmomo ed arap nen Adan

location.label: Say Sagradon Pasen
options: Jannah (Paraiso)
Sakey a makapadinayew a palasyo ed Nilo
Sakey a tori na laryo ya onsasabi ed tawen
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka a ginawa manlapud saray alahas
Sakey a hurnoan na mandarlang ya apoy

outcome.label: Say Kaunoran a Kapalaran
options: Ipaway, ya walay painawa anggad insipan ya Agew
Nalner a kaiba iray armada ed silong na daluyon
Nadederal na saray bato ya imbantak manlapud tawen
Nabubuyak na saray pulok na manok ya ontitikyab
Naupot na sakey a maksil ya insabog
outcome.answer: Ipaway, ya walay painawa anggad insipan ya Agew

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
